remarks: Welcome to this sun-filled, move-in ready 2 bed/1.5 bath townhouse in the highly sought-after Green Oaks complex! The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living, dining & kitchen areas, all featuring beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The updated kitchen impresses with shaker cabinets, quartz counters and stainless steel appliances, while the living & dining area is perfect for entertaining with sliders leading to an oversized private deck - ideal for outdoor living. Upstairs features two spacious bedrooms & a renovated full bath. Updated half bath completes the main level. The finished lower level offers additional flexible living space & convenient in-unit laundry. Enjoy the convenience of an attached 1-car garage with direct entry into the unit, along with an additional unassigned parking space. Enjoy the park-like complex featuring a fenced-in pool, all on a quiet street yet walking distance to shopping, restaurants, grocery & Home Depot - just a stone's throw to Old Greenwich & minutes to downtown Stamford & I-95. Don't miss this opportunity!
